lines.t:
Okay, {{medachange}} attack, go! ...Huh?
The {{charge_gauge}} is going down?

While Medachanged, every action
uses up the {{charge_gauge}}.

Also, charging during {{medachange}}
doesn't fill the {{charge_gauge}}.

And when the {{charge_gauge}} hits 10%
or less, {{medachange}} ends.

You can also end it yourself by selecting
{{medachange}} with the $ｷ button.

Next, I'll explain what you can do
while Medachanged.

When you {{medachange}}, you can't use
your original head and arm {{part|pl}}.

Instead, you can choose the three
{{medachange}} commands, "Drives".

Unlike head {{part|pl}}, these have no limit
on the number of uses.

Many Medachange commands are
powerful, so they can give you the edge.

Now, make full use of {{medachange}}
and win this {{robattle}}.
